geo_headlines: Sat 7/11 evening ET: US CENTCOM launched THIRD round of strikes at 7:15pm ET against Iran after IRGC attacked M/V GFS Galaxy (Cyprus-flagged container ship, civilian crew member missing, engine room damaged, on fire). Strikes hit Iranian radars, launchers, missile and drone storage depots. Explosions Bandar Abbas, Sirik, Chabahar (CENTCOM/WSJ/Mint/Anadolu)

Iran declared Strait of Hormuz CLOSED 'until further notice, until US intervention ends' after firing warning shots at the GFS Galaxy. Ship was on the US-cleared southern (Omani-waters) route. IRGC: 'we warned to alter course, they ignored it.' This is the first formal declared closure of the current conflict (Mint/India Today/ChosunBiz/Reuters)
